name: KtglEventSet
description: KTGL auto-reset event signal: lock, flag +0x99 = 1, notify condvar +0x50, unlock (72 callers); pairs with KtglEventWait 0x3d7cc8

name: KtglEventWait
description: KTGL event wait (mutex + std::condition_variable, flag +0x99, auto-reset +0x98, INFINITE; 170 callers); effect workers and the effect-group joins block here

name: EffectManagerUpdateInstances
signature: void EffectManagerUpdateInstances(EffectMgr* m, void* scene, EffectPassParams* p)
description: Per-pass walk over EVERY live effect instance (std::map at [m]) on KIDSTaskScheduler0: removal checks, owner/visibility/display-distance tests -> disp flag; parallel mode: invisible -> EffectNoDispEnqueue (0x160b83), visible -> Disp list (0x160fc0); otherwise inline EffectSystemUpdate

name: EffectManagerUpdateInstances_CallNoDispEnqueue
description: Only caller of EffectNoDispEnqueue (E8 70 9B 5D 00); fx_live E1 site B -> call cave (invisible effects updated every N-th pass with dt*N)

name: EffectManagerUpdateInstances_CallDispEnqueue
description: Visible-effect enqueue: push {sys,obj,dt,attachPos} onto Disp list [mgr+0x3500+idx*0x18], idx round robin % [mgr+0x7000]

name: EffectManagerFrameUpdate
signature: void EffectManagerFrameUpdate(EffectMgr* m, void* scene, f32 dt, f32 dtRaw)
description: Per-frame effect manager step inside GameModeUpdateMain: EffectThreadListsReset, pass params (0x8bbf7c), EffectManagerUpdateInstances, then EffectDispKick when parallel and sets mgr+0x48

name: GameModeUpdateMain
description: Game-world update on KIDSTaskScheduler0 (35-37% incl in r5/ingame2/r7): first EffectNoDispJoinIfPending (joins last frame's invisible-effect worker), then ~60 subsystem updates incl. CharacterUpdateDispatchIfActive (0x396e38) and EffectManagerFrameUpdate. Better description for the mainthread-logic.tsv row (same name)

name: GameModePostUpdate
signature: void GameModePostUpdate(void* self, void* scene, bool full)
description: End of the game update: EffectDispJoinIfPending (0x56614c), then EffectNoDispKick and mgr+0x49 = 1 (that worker is joined at the start of the next GameModeUpdateMain)

name: EffectNoDispKick
description: g_EffectThreadsRunning = 1; KtglEventSet(start event +0x3808 + i*0x1a8) for each of the [m+0x7004] NoDisp workers

name: EffectDispJoinIfPending
description: if mgr+0x48: EffectDispJoin, then clear

name: EffectDispKick
description: g_EffectThreadsRunning = 1; KtglEventSet(start event +0x8 + i*0x1a8) for each of the [m+0x7000] Disp workers

name: EffectDispJoin
description: KtglEventWait(done +0xa8 + i*0x1a8) for each Disp worker; runs on KIDSTaskScheduler0, never on [App]Game

name: EffectNoDispJoinIfPending
description: if mgr+0x49: EffectNoDispJoin, then clear; first call of GameModeUpdateMain

name: EffectNoDispJoin
description: KtglEventWait(done +0x38a8 + i*0x1a8) for each of the [m+0x7004] NoDisp workers (1 on this PC)

name: EffectThreadListsReset
description: end = begin for every Disp (+0x3500) and NoDisp (+0x6d00) entry vector; once per pass from EffectManagerFrameUpdate, also from the clear-all 0x20aaa34; fx_live E1 site A (pass counter)

name: EffectNoDispEnqueue
signature: void EffectNoDispEnqueue(EffectThreadMgr* m, int idx, EffectSystem* sys, f32 dt)
description: push {sys, obj=0, dt, identity pos} onto NoDisp list [m+0x6d00+idx*0x18]; single caller 0x160b83

name: EffectWorkEntryPushBack
signature: EffectWorkEntry* EffectWorkEntryPushBack(Vec* v, const EffectWorkEntry* e)
description: std::vector of 0x30-byte entries push_back (grow path 0x1005934); used for the Disp lists (0x160fc0) and by 0x1a72c00

name: EffectThreadManagerInit
description: Creates the effect worker groups: Disp count = pool 56 (9 here), NoDisp count = pool 57 (1 here); per-thread entry vectors reserved 1275/n; arrays sized for 32 workers

name: EffectUpdateThreadStart
signature: bool EffectUpdateThreadStart(EffectWorker* w, void* a2, void* a3, void* a4, u32 a5, EffectWorkList* list)
description: stores list at w+0x1a0 and starts EffectUpdateThreadMain as "[App]EffectUpdateThread" (stack 0x40000)

name: EffectUpdateThreadMain
description: loop: KtglEventWait(w+8); quit flag w+0x150; vtable+0x10 (EffectWorkerRunList); KtglEventSet(w+0xa8)

name: EffectWorkerRunList
description: Worker job (vtable slot 0x402d778): per 0x30-byte entry: if obj and attach pos != identity -> set pos, EffectSystemUpdate(sys, dt*0.5), reset pos, EffectSystemUpdate(sys, dt*0.5) (sub-stepped emission); else if dt>0 one update; then release the obj ref. No-op unless g_EffectThreadsRunning == 1

name: EffectSystemUpdate
description: KTGL effect update: tracks (count +0xc8, stride 0xf0, flags +0xf8 bit0 active, bit1 started) advance time; started tracks update every child (vtable+0x40, default EffectEmitterUpdate); 4-entry dt history if +0xcc & 0x100; 9 callers

name: EffectEmitterUpdate
description: Default effect child update: fade-out (+0x28..+0x34) and release when faded, per-node bindings, particle groups by type (table 0x3be3c98 stride 0x170, 0xc8498 type switch), allocator compaction

name: EffectCreate
signature: EffectHandle* EffectCreate(void* mgr, EffectHandle* out, u32 effectId, ...)
description: Effect spawn (23 callers). Only functional consumer of VISUAL_EFFECT: when LIMITED and the effect definition flags (+0xc) have 0x800000, returns a null handle (the effect is never spawned)

name: EffectCreate_VisualEffectGate
description: cmp [g_CfgVisualEffect],r13d: the VISUAL_EFFECT=LIMITED drop of optional (definition flag 0x800000) effects

name: CharacterUpdateDispatchIfActive
signature: void CharacterUpdateDispatchIfActive(void* scene, f32 dt, f32 dtRaw)
description: if [0x4745348] (actor manager) != 0 -> CharacterUpdateDispatch; called from GameModeUpdateMain

name: CharacterUpdateDispatch
signature: void CharacterUpdateDispatch(ActorMgr* a, void* scene, f32 dt, f32 dtRaw)
description: Builds the 0xe0-byte update-param block (MotionLodParamsBuild) and runs CharacterUpdateBalanceAndRun over the actor list a+0xba0

name: MotionLodParamsBuild
signature: void* MotionLodParamsBuild(u32* p, f32 dt, f32 dtRaw, void* cam)
description: Fills the per-frame character update block: [0..1] dt, [4..7] camera pos, +0x3c = GetLodLevelCount (MOTION_QUALITY 8/6/4), +0x50 = 1+(MOTION_QUALITY==LIGHT), distances 1000/3000/1500. Only bytes 0..0x1f are consumed downstream (copied to g_CharacterUpdateParams), so the MOTION_QUALITY fields are dead stores in v2.02

name: CharacterUpdateBalanceAndRun
signature: void CharacterUpdateBalanceAndRun(int* p, Scene* s, ActorRange* r, void* params)
description: Assigns every actor with +0x7c4==0 to the least-loaded of n buckets by cost (+0xb030/+0xb034/+0xb038), dispatches jobs (0x31a86c, 0x31a2c0), joins with CharacterUpdateJoin; no visibility or distance test at this level

name: CharacterUpdateJoin
description: if a+0x1408: job-counter wait 0x3e7cc(c,0) (KIDSTaskScheduler0 helps/waits on the character jobs), then clear

name: CharacterJobsDispatchA
signature: void CharacterJobsDispatchA(ActorMgr* a, JobCounter* c, int kind, void* params)
description: copies params[0..0x1f] to g_CharacterUpdateParams, counts and pushes per-actor jobs (0x31a928/0x31a1dc)

name: CharacterJobsDispatchB
signature: void CharacterJobsDispatchB(u32* a, Scene* s, JobCounter* c, int kind, void* params)
description: copies params[0..0x1f] to g_CharacterUpdateParams, builds a job group and pushes one job per bucket (0x31a420) round robin

name: IsMotionQualityLightPlus1
description: 1 + (GetMotionQualityTier()==2, i.e. MOTION_QUALITY LIGHT); only consumer MotionLodParamsBuild (+0x50, dead)

name: GetMotionQualityTier
description: MOTION_QUALITY index -> tier: HIGH 0, STANDARD 1, LIGHT 2; the only reader of g_CfgMotionQuality besides menu/save/sync thunks. Better name for existing row GetLodTier

name: GetLodLevelCount
description: MOTION_QUALITY tier -> 8/6/4 (8 if no actor manager; 1 when [0x4745348]+0x1430). Lands in MotionLodParamsBuild +0x3c, which nothing reads in v2.02 (Nioh3Fix sig #19 'Motion Quality' hooks this mov edx,8). Better description for the existing row

name: CharacterActivationUpdate
description: Per-character in-range state: +0xae14 active flag (UpdateCharacterLodDistance / distance tests); inactive -> +0x8a4 = 2 and the reduced path (0x42e314 or CharacterDistanceLodState)

name: CharacterDistanceLodState
description: Sets +0xb124 = 2 (near) / 3 (far) with hysteresis at 18 m / 20 m from the player (squared 3.24e6 / 4e6); consumed by CharacterModelLodApply

name: CharacterModelLodApply
description: Per-character model/anim LOD apply: +0xb124 state 3 -> far flags to the model (0x42f018/0x42eec4) and the second body (+0x9f0)

name: CharacterAttachmentUpdate
description: Per-character attachment/sub-object update, skipped when the owner is more than 1800 (18 m) from the camera (+0xae18) unless in a special state

name: CharacterFarCullFlag
description: Sets out+0x3b3 when camera distance +0xae18 exceeds a per-model distance (table 0x3978248 indexed by [0x45baf7c]*0x40, overridable by model +0xee*100)

name: g_EffectThreadsRunning
description: Set to 1 by EffectDispKick / EffectNoDispKick (and 0x20adf60); EffectWorkerRunList does nothing unless it is 1

name: g_pEffectThreadMgr
description: Effect worker-group manager (EffectThreadManagerInit); read by EffectManagerUpdateInstances for the round-robin list indices

name: g_CharacterUpdateParams
description: First 0x20 bytes of the MotionLodParamsBuild block (dt, dtRaw, camera pos), written by CharacterJobsDispatchA/B, read by the per-actor jobs; the MOTION_QUALITY fields beyond 0x20 are not copied

name: g_WorkerPoolTable
description: Worker-pool table, 74 records of 0x18: +0 name ptr, +8 prio i32, +0xc thread count u8, +0x10 weight i32 (-1 = fixed). re/settings/threads.txt pairs each count with the NEXT record's name (off by one). Live counts: KIDSTaskScheduler 7, ResourceLoad 4, StageUpdate 8, CharacterUpdate 8, CollisionUpdate 9, StgGdtUpd 4, PhysUpdate 2, EffectUpdateDisp 9, EffectUpdateNoDisp 1. Better description for the existing row

name: WorkerPoolEntry::Name
description: pool name

name: WorkerPoolEntry::Priority
description: thread priority

name: WorkerPoolEntry::ThreadCount
description: threads created for the pool (after SizeWorkerPools)

name: WorkerPoolEntry::Weight
description: share of the worker budget, -1 = fixed count

name: EffectThreadMgr::DispLists
description: per Disp worker entry vector (stride 0x18)

name: EffectThreadMgr::NoDispWorkers
description: NoDisp worker objects (stride 0x1a8); Disp workers start at +0

name: EffectThreadMgr::NoDispLists
description: per NoDisp worker entry vector (stride 0x18)

name: EffectThreadMgr::DispCount
description: Disp worker count (pool 56; 9 here)

name: EffectThreadMgr::NoDispCount
description: NoDisp worker count (pool 57; 1 here)

name: EffectWorker::StartEvent
description: signalled by the kick functions

name: EffectWorker::DoneEvent
description: signalled after each list run; waited on by the joins

name: EffectWorker::List
description: this worker's entry vector

name: EffectWorkEntry::Sys
description: effect system to update

name: EffectWorkEntry::Obj
description: attached object (0 for NoDisp entries); its ref is released after the update

name: EffectWorkEntry::Dt
description: step in seconds (frame step / 60)

name: EffectWorkEntry::AttachPos
description: attach offset; != identity -> two half-step updates

name: EffectMgr::DispPending
description: set after EffectDispKick, cleared by EffectDispJoinIfPending

name: EffectMgr::NoDispPending
description: set after EffectNoDispKick, cleared by EffectNoDispJoinIfPending

name: Character::DistanceLodState
description: 2 near / 3 far (18-20 m hysteresis), set by CharacterDistanceLodState

name: Character::ActiveInRange
description: in-range/active flag (UpdateCharacterLodDistance, CharacterActivationUpdate)
